records.title: Registration
records.introduction: Start with your passport and travel basics. If a passport/name gate appears, complete it on the official portal first.

groups.title: Passport / name gate
groups.note: Before registration, if shown. Observed separately from the main form.

fields.label: Passport No
fields.hint: Use the passport you’ll travel with.

fields.label: Select Country/Region
fields.hint: Choose the country/region of your passport.

fields.label: Name as in passport
fields.hint: Match the full name in your passport.

groups.title: Application registration
groups.note: Order observed on 18 October 2026 after selecting U.S. nationality and an ordinary passport. Purpose and Visa Service are derived read-only summaries.

fields.label: Nationality/Region
fields.hint: Use the nationality of the passport you’ll travel on.

fields.label: Passport Type
fields.hint: Check the passport type printed in your travel document.

fields.label: Port Of Arrival
fields.hint: Search by city, airport name or code. Choose the matching portal entry.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.hint: Day first, then month and year.

fields.label: Email ID
fields.hint: Use an inbox you can access for visa updates.

fields.label: Re-enter Email ID
fields.hint: Repeat your email address to catch typos before visa updates are sent.

fields.label: Visiting India for
fields.hint: Search your reason for visiting, then match the service and duration on your form.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.hint: The portal fills this from Visiting India for.

fields.label: Visa Service
fields.hint: Visa Service is filled automatically from your Visiting India for choice.

fields.label: Expected Date of Arrival
fields.hint: Enter the date you expect to arrive in India, in DD/MM/YYYY format.

records.nextAction: On the official portal, review the details and use Continue. Complete the CAPTCHA there.

records.title: Personal & passport

fields.label: Surname (exactly as in your Passport)
fields.hint: Your family name, exactly as printed in your passport.

fields.label: Given Name/s (exactly as in your Passport)
fields.hint: Include all first and middle names in passport order.

fields.label: Have you ever changed your name? If yes, click the box and give details.
fields.hint: Include a legal name change, such as a surname changed after marriage.

fields.label: Previous Surname
fields.hint: Use your former names if the form asks for them.
fields.when: If name change is checked

fields.label: Previous Name
fields.hint: Previous given name
fields.when: If name change is checked

fields.label: Gender
fields.hint: Choose the option that matches the gender recorded in your passport.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.hint: Date of Birth as in Passport in DD/MM/YYYY format

fields.label: Town/City of birth
fields.hint: Match the place of birth recorded in your passport.

fields.label: Country/Region of birth
fields.hint: Choose your country of birth.

fields.label: Citizenship/National Id No.
fields.hint: U.S. applicant without a national ID? Enter NA.

fields.label: Religion
fields.hint: Agnostic, atheist or non-religious? Choose OTHERS and fill in the explanation.

fields.label: If Others, Please specify
fields.hint: Enter your explanation, or NA if not applicable.
fields.when: If Religion is OTHERS

fields.label: Visible identification marks
fields.hint: Describe a visible identifying mark, such as a scar or mole.

fields.label: Educational Qualification
fields.hint: Choose the option that matches your highest qualification.

fields.label: Qualification acquired from College/University
fields.hint: Complete Qualification acquired from College/University as requested on the official form.

fields.label: Nationality/Region
fields.hint: Complete Nationality/Region as requested on the official form.

fields.label: Did you acquire Nationality by birth or by naturalization?
fields.hint: Choose how you acquired your current citizenship.

fields.label: Prev. Nationality/Region
fields.hint: If naturalized, give your previous nationality when requested.
fields.when: If nationality acquired by Naturalization

fields.label: Have you lived for at least two years in the country where you are applying visa?
fields.hint: Answer for your country of application.

fields.label: Passport Number
fields.hint: Use the number on the passport you’ll travel with.

fields.label: Place of Issue
fields.hint: Use the place or issuing country shown in your passport.

fields.label: Date of Issue
fields.hint: Use the passport issue date.

fields.label: Date of Expiry
fields.hint: Use the expiry date printed in your passport.

fields.label: Any other valid Passport/Identity Certificate(IC) held,
fields.hint: If yes, prepare details of the other valid document.

fields.label: Country of Issue
fields.hint: Use the details on the other valid document.
fields.when: If another valid Passport/Identity Certificate is held

fields.label: Passport/IC No.
fields.hint: Use the details on the other valid document.
fields.when: If another valid Passport/Identity Certificate is held

fields.label: Date of Issue
fields.hint: Use the issue date of the other document.
fields.when: If another valid Passport/Identity Certificate is held

fields.label: Place of Issue
fields.hint: Use the details on the other valid document.
fields.when: If another valid Passport/Identity Certificate is held

fields.label: Nationality mentioned therein
fields.hint: Use the details on the other valid document.
fields.when: If another valid Passport/Identity Certificate is held

records.nextAction: Continue on the official portal after checking your answers.

records.title: Address & family

fields.label: House No./Street
fields.hint: Keep each address line within 35 characters.

fields.label: Village/Town/City
fields.hint: Use your city or town, not your neighborhood.

fields.label: Country
fields.hint: Country of your current residence.

fields.label: State/Province/District
fields.hint: Use the state, province or district for your address.

fields.label: Postal/Zip Code
fields.hint: Keep leading zeros and any required letters or spaces.

fields.label: Phone No.
fields.hint: Enter your contact number. Complete Mobile No. as well if the portal requires it.

fields.label: Mobile No.
fields.hint: Enter your mobile number; the tested form required it even with Phone No. filled.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.hint: Complete Email Address as requested on the official form.

fields.label: Click here for same address
fields.hint: Use this checkbox on the official form only if your permanent and present addresses are the same.

fields.label: House No./Street
fields.hint: Enter your permanent address, including its postal / ZIP code as requested.

fields.label: Village/Town/City
fields.hint: Use the city or town in your permanent address.

fields.label: State/Province/District
fields.hint: Use the state, province or district for your permanent address.

fields.label: Name
fields.hint: Name as recorded in your family documents.

fields.label: Nationality/Region
fields.hint: Current nationality.

fields.label: Previous Nationality/Region
fields.hint: Previous nationality, if applicable.

fields.label: Place of birth
fields.hint: Town or city of birth.

fields.label: Country/Region of birth
fields.hint: Country of birth.

fields.label: Name
fields.hint: Name as recorded in your family documents.

fields.label: Nationality/Region
fields.hint: Current nationality.

fields.label: Previous Nationality/Region
fields.hint: Previous nationality, if applicable.

fields.label: Place of birth
fields.hint: Town or city of birth.

fields.label: Country/Region of birth
fields.hint: Country of birth.

fields.label: Applicant's Marital Status
fields.hint: Use your current status. Married applicants may need spouse details.

fields.label: Name
fields.hint: Use your spouse’s full name.
fields.when: If marital status is MARRIED

fields.label: Nationality/Region
fields.hint: Use your spouse’s citizenship.
fields.when: If marital status is MARRIED

fields.label: Previous Nationality/Region
fields.hint: Complete Previous Nationality/Region as requested on the official form.
fields.when: If marital status is MARRIED

fields.label: Place of birth
fields.hint: Use your spouse’s place of birth.
fields.when: If marital status is MARRIED

fields.label: Country/Region of birth
fields.hint: Use your spouse’s country of birth.
fields.when: If marital status is MARRIED

fields.label: Were your Parents/Grandparents (paternal/maternal) Pakistan Nationals or Belong to Pakistan held area.
fields.hint: Read the full live question and answer accurately.

fields.label: If Yes, give details
fields.hint: Provide the details requested by the portal.
fields.when: If Pakistan family question is Yes

fields.label: Present Occupation
fields.hint: Choose your current occupation from the official form.

fields.label: Other occupation
fields.hint: Complete Other occupation as requested on the official form.
fields.when: If Present Occupation is OTHERS

fields.label: Specify below occupation details of
fields.hint: In case of HouseWife/Student/Minor Please specify Spouse/Parent's Occupation details.
fields.when: Shown for STUDENT; help also mentions HouseWife/Student/Minor

fields.label: Employer Name/business
fields.hint: Keep the employer or business name accurate.

fields.label: Designation
fields.hint: Designation means your job title, such as Software Engineer, Teacher or Manager.

fields.label: Address
fields.hint: Use your employer’s full address.

fields.label: Phone
fields.hint: Your employer’s phone number. This field is optional.

fields.label: Past Occupation, if any
fields.hint: Complete Past Occupation, if any as requested on the official form.

fields.label: Other past occupation
fields.hint: Complete Other past occupation as requested on the official form.

fields.label: Are/were you in a Military/Semi-Military/Police/Security. Organization?
fields.hint: Read the full question; include past service if asked.

fields.label: Organization
fields.hint: Give the service details requested on the official form.
fields.when: If military / police / security service is Yes

fields.label: Designation
fields.hint: Complete Designation as requested on the official form.

fields.label: Rank
fields.hint: Complete Rank as requested on the official form.

fields.label: Place of Posting
fields.hint: Complete Place of Posting as requested on the official form.

records.title: Visit & references

fields.label: Places to be visited
fields.hint: List your planned places. Check official guidance before visiting restricted areas.

fields.label: Places to be visited line 2

fields.label: Place/City of Hotel/Resort etc

fields.label: Port of Arrival in India

fields.label: Expected Port of Exit from India

fields.label: Have you ever visited India before?

fields.label: Address

records.title: Upload photograph
records.introduction: Prepare your photo locally, then choose and upload the finished JPEG on the official portal.

fields.label: Choose the Photo To Upload
fields.hint: Choose a clear, front-facing JPEG, 10 KB–1 MB and at least 350 × 350 pixels, with a white or light background.

fields.label: Upload Photo
fields.hint: Choosing a file is only the first step. Use the separate Upload Photo action shown on the official page and check the result.

records.nextAction: Follow the official photo preview and any crop/confirmation steps it displays. Continue after the portal accepts the upload.

callout.title: Get your photo ready
callout.description: Crop and resize your photo to a square JPEG, then upload it on the official form.

records.title: Upload passport
records.introduction: Use the biodata page of the same passport entered in Passport Details. Check the document is legible before uploading it on the official portal.

fields.label: Copy of Passport page containing personal particulars
fields.hint: Choose your passport PDF on the official page. Published guidance specifies 10 KB–300 KB.

fields.label: Upload Document
fields.hint: Use the separate upload action after choosing the file.

fields.label: Status
fields.hint: Check the upload status; do not continue while it still shows Not Uploaded.

fields.label: I have verified that all the documents are uploaded as per the requirement.
fields.hint: Check the uploaded file and all document requirements before selecting this confirmation on the official page.

records.nextAction: Use Confirm on the official page once the upload and document checks are complete.

callout.title: Make your passport PDF
callout.description: Crop your passport’s photo and details page and convert it to a PDF for the official form.

records.title: Payment
records.introduction: Finish payment only through the official portal. The companion never collects payment details or submits your application.

fields.label: Applicant Name
fields.hint: Check the name displayed on the official page.

fields.label: Application Id
fields.hint: Keep the application ID from the portal for status checks.

fields.label: Generate Application Form
fields.hint: Use the official page’s download action if you want a copy of the application.

fields.label: Disclaimer
fields.hint: Read the complete current disclaimer on the portal.

fields.label: Undertaking
fields.hint: Read the full undertaking before selecting Yes or No on the official page.

fields.label: Pay Now / Pay Later
fields.hint: Follow the current official payment instructions and check payment status before retrying a payment.

records.nextAction: Completing this guide does not mean your visa is approved. Check your application status on the official portal and keep your ETA when approved.
